title: Kokoro Voice Laboratory · Session 01
source_sentence: I said it could evolve, not that it had to.

samples.label: 01 · Original take
samples.method: Original words, punctuation, voice blend, and 1.04 speed

samples.label: 02 · Stress marks
samples.note: Tests native phonological stress; it may be very subtle.

samples.label: 03 · The em dash
samples.method: Replace the comma with an em dash, otherwise unchanged
samples.note: Tests whether a punctuation cue reshapes the sentence.

samples.label: 04 · Directed pause
samples.method: Two separately synthesised clauses + exactly 430 ms of silence
samples.note: Pacing and sentence segmentation, with a deliberate beat.

samples.label: 05 · Slightly faster
samples.note: A small proposed adjustment for future episodes.

samples.label: 06 · Lower pitch
samples.method: The original take, post-processed at 0.955× pitch
samples.note: Should sound modestly deeper while preserving approximately the same duration.

samples.label: 07 · Higher pitch
samples.method: The original take, post-processed at 1.055× pitch
samples.note: Should sound modestly brighter; this is not pitch-contour editing.

samples.label: 08 · Across the room
samples.method: Low-pass filter, short echoes, reduced gain
samples.note: Changes acoustic location, not the speaker's acting or emotion.

samples.label: 09 · Two-host scene
samples.method: Kore/Nova host + George counsel; timing, stress, synthetic gavel
samples.note: A miniature scene combining the controls, rather than an A/B comparison.

warning: A/B judgments are subjective; tests vary only the specified production dimension where feasible. The directed pause also changes segmentation and punctuation.
